datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Somalia, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The data represents medium-term projections for 2022 and is provided as spatial features (GeoJSON/KML) with classification values, collection dates, and scenario information.
